 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Extract the left mask from a vertically divided paired pattern.

    ARC task shows two patterns separated by a solid nonzero vertical bar;
    the left-side nonzero cells become color 2. For the stacked demonstration
    format, a solid horizontal bar separates the lower output mask.
    """
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for c in range(w):
        if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] and row[c] != 0 for row in grid):
            return [[2 if x else 0 for x in row[:c]] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        if all(x == grid[r][0] and x != 0 for x in grid[r]):
            return [[2 if x else 0 for x in row] for row in grid[r + 1:]]
    raise ValueError('No solid nonzero separator found')
